supportingSources.label: Keith Elwin at PAPA Circuit Final 2017-18

strategy.summary: Complete the center three-bank and left five-bank to raise Bonus X to 14x. Use the two-button lane change to fill the bonus grid. Start three-ball play only when SKY DIVERS and Walker progress come safely.

quickInfo.name: Bonus grid
quickInfo.summary: The center drops choose columns, a two-button lane change moves the selected row, and completed lines add multiplied bonus.

quickInfo.name: Center three-bank
quickInfo.summary: Each target fills its column on the selected grid row, and completing the bank advances Bonus X.

quickInfo.name: Left five-bank
quickInfo.summary: Each bank completion advances Bonus X; hitting 1 through 5 in order also scores 50,000 and lights the Altitude-lane Special.

quickInfo.name: 14x Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: The maximum end-of-ball multiplier makes completed grid lines and preserved bonus the main scoring engine.

quickInfo.name: Three-ball feature
quickInfo.summary: Complete SKY DIVERS to light the Walker, load two balls there, then send the third ball through it to start three-ball play.

steps.text: Hold both flipper buttons, then release one once per advance to move the selected bonus-grid row.
Complete the center three-bank whenever its rebound is controlled.
Complete the left five-bank. When practical, hit 1 through 5 in order for 50,000 and a lit Altitude-lane Special.
Repeat both banks until Bonus X reaches 14x.
Continue lane-change work to fill high-value grid spaces. Protect the built bonus instead of forcing a low-value target.
When SKY DIVERS is complete and two balls are loaded, send the third ball through the Walker to start the three-ball feature.
modeNotes: Three-ball feature: Light SKY DIVERS, load two balls, then send the third ball through the Walker to release three-ball play.
Protected use: Use the extra balls to finish bank, grid, and Bonus X progress.

steps.text: During three-ball play, continue the safest Bonus X and grid shots. Return to bonus control after one ball remains.

fallback.title: Grid and 14x bonus
fallback.when: Use this when Walker progress or SKY DIVERS targets are unsafe.

steps.text: Use lane change to complete useful bonus-grid rows.
Finish the center three-bank from controlled feeds.
Complete the left five-bank; preserve 1-to-5 order only when the needed target is safe.
Reach 14x and protect the end-of-ball bonus.

alternatives.title: Direct three-ball feature
alternatives.when: Use this when SKY DIVERS and Walker shots are safer than the drop banks.

steps.text: Complete the SKY DIVERS runway lights.
Shoot the lit Walker once to load the first ball, then shoot it again to load the second.
Shoot the Walker a third time to start three-ball play.
Use the extra balls to complete grid and bank progress.
Complete upper switch groups until Bonus X reaches 14x.
Use lane change to fill the strongest bonus-card rows.
Complete SKY DIVERS and load all three Walker positions.
Use three-ball play to extend the 14x grid-scoring ball.

techniques.name: Bonus-grid lane change
techniques.instruction: Hold both flipper buttons, then release one once for each row advance. Stop when the needed grid row is selected.

techniques.name: Ordered five-bank control
techniques.instruction: Read the raised targets before you flip. Shoot only the next required target in the 1-to-5 sequence.

cautions.issue: Drop-bank rebounds can remove control before the required target sequence is complete.
cautions.response: Use a cradle before each bank shot. Do not hit a lowered target or a target that is out of sequence.

cautions.issue: Walker loading adds live balls without a Jackpot or a separate scoring objective.
cautions.response: Start the feature only when the extra balls protect valuable grid or multiplier progress.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm the 1981 Stern Freefall, ball count, Bonus X carry, card-completion carry, Reserve Bonus, Special and Extra Ball conversion, and tilt.
Confirm SKY DIVERS and Walker start requirements, numbered-bank award, grid-line values, maximum Extra Balls, and whether tournament scoring rewards Special.
Test two-button lane change, both drop banks, Walker loading and release, SKY DIVERS switches, kickers, spinner, and outlane posts before choosing the route.
strategy.simpleOverview: Freefall turns two drop banks and two-button lane change into a bonus grid multiplied by Bonus X. Complete the center and left banks until 14x, move the selected grid row for valuable lines, and start three-ball play only when SKY DIVERS and Walker shots are safe.
